text: ASTRAL estimates a species tree from a set of input gene trees by minimizing quartet distance, which helps account for discordance caused by incomplete lineage sorting.
explanation: This is true: ASTRAL is a coalescent-aware method that takes individual gene trees and finds the species tree minimizing quartet distance to them, explicitly modeling incomplete lineage sorting via the multi-species coalescent. This makes it well suited to situations of rapid radiation where many gene trees conflict with each other.
